newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana shares recover some ground in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Ghana shares recover some ground in quiet trade.

text.p: Ghanaian shares recovered some ground on Wednesday after falling heavily at the start of the week, but the cautious mood continued.
The All-Share Index edged up slightly by 0.28 points to close better at 357.23 points.
The number of shares offered remained far above bids at 1,248,160 to 162,840, with a mere 18,260 shares changing hands.

On the broader market, the breweries made significant gains being the only two gainers against one decliner -- with Kumasi Brewery Ltd up 25 cedis to 655 cedis and Accra Brewery Ltd gaining 10 cedis to 560 cedis.
Fan Miilk Ltd, the only loser, declined by two cedis to 402.
